article.title: Attain把購物受眾原生接入Amazon Ads DVA+，由量度延伸至投放
article.title_en: Attain adds native purchase audiences to Amazon Ads DVA+, extending beyond measurement
article.summary: 11月4日公告讓廣告主直接使用Attain購物受眾，新增按零售商及購物渠道劃分的選項。
article.summary_en: The November 4 release enables native use of Attain purchase audiences with retailer and shopping-channel segments.
highlights: 可按零售商組合、商品類別及線上或店內購買分組。
公司稱經授權的購物訊號每日更新；資料背景為美國市場。
highlights_en: Segments cover retailer combinations, purchase categories and online or in-store shopping.
Attain says permissioned purchase signals refresh daily; the data context is the US.
article.why: 面向美國市場的旅遊、餐飲及零售廣告主，可評估實際購物訊號能否補充既有受眾設定。
article.why_en: Travel, restaurant and retail advertisers targeting the US can assess purchase signals alongside existing audience definitions.
article.next_step: 先確認可購受眾的地區、門檻及資料用途，再以對照組檢查增量，避免只看平台歸因。
article.next_step_en: Confirm geography, minimums and permitted uses, then evaluate incrementality against a control rather than attribution alone.
article.detail: Attain與Amazon在2025年的合作已涉及線下銷售增量量度，今次公告的變化是把購物訊號帶到投放前的受眾建立及啟用。這不是新增一份已證實的成效研究。公司亦提到未在Amazon銷售的品牌可使用相關訊號；這描述應用對象，並不保證每個帳戶或市場都有相同資料。香港團隊若服務美國客戶，可先查清資料地區與使用條款，不能直接套用至香港消費者。
article.detail_en: The 2025 relationship involved offline sales-lift measurement; the new step is audience activation earlier in campaigns. This is not evidence of improved results. Non-Amazon sellers are an intended use case, not proof of identical coverage for every market or account. Check US targeting and permitted data uses.
